mapper.select: SELECT e.*, d.name AS department_name, des.name AS designation_name, b.name AS branch_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN designations des ON des.id = e.designation_id LEFT JOIN branches b ON b.id = e.branch_id WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT e.*, d.name AS department_name, des.name AS designation_name, b.name AS branch_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN designations des ON des.id = e.designation_id LEFT JOIN branches b ON b.id = e.branch_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.company_id = #{companyId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, work_email = #{workEmail}, personal_phone = #{personalPhone}, department_id = #{departmentId}, designation_id = #{designationId}, employment_type = #{employmentType}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}

UPDATE employees SET photo_url = COALESCE(#{photoUrl}, photo_url), personal_phone = COALESCE(#{personalPhone}, personal_phone), address_line1 = COALESCE(#{addressLine1}, address_line1), city = COALESCE(#{city}, city), state = COALESCE(#{state}, state), postal_code = COALESCE(#{postalCode}, postal_code), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: SELECT 'EMP-' || LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1001 AS TEXT), 4, '0') FROM employees

SELECT e.id AS employeeId, e.employee_code AS employeeCode, e.first_name AS firstName, e.last_name AS lastName, d.name AS departmentName, des.name AS designationName, e.work_email AS workEmail, u.id AS userId, u.email AS userEmail, COALESCE(u.is_active, FALSE) AS userActive FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN designations des ON des.id = e.designation_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = e.user_id OR u.employee_id = e.id OR u.email = e.work_email WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY e.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET user_id = #{userId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{employeeId} AND company_id = #{companyId}
